summary: Signal Stage is a multiplayer walkable motion-graphics stage with a synchronized, seeded 198-second cinematic on the measured 160-bpm track. The director deals both scene variations and vision slots, sending shared timing and parameters to shader-built field, eye, serpents, tunnel, chamber, celestial vision assemblies and the full-screen look; camera and HUD follow the same roll state.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main, 3D) - black void, spawn at (0, 0.1, 16), gravity and place-wide scripts/look-trip.js atmosphere look.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - #director and stage floor, field/eye/serpents assemblies; eye portal at (0,15,-34), field at origin.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - sun-eye layers above the stage and five tunnel layers along -Z.
places/main/cells/x0z-3.scene - chamber room/circuit/hands/hex/Lissajous/mask/solids plus tunnel-knot at the tunnel end.
places/main/cells/x0y2z0.scene - three-layer vision-sun-father assembly at y=300.
places/main/cells/x0y3z0.scene and x0y4z0.scene - three-layer vision-moon-mother at y=420; vision-contour-oracle at y=500.
places/main/cells/x0y5z0.scene - three-layer vision-many-armed assembly at y=620; these four built visions occupy separate high-altitude patches of black.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer services, player/camera templates, movement and cine actions, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player composes humanoid-locomotion.js with scripts/player.js; templates/camera.js#camera runs scripts/camera.js.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - scripts/stage.js synchronizes the track and pushes roll/deal parameters.
scripts/ui.js - viewer-local ROLL/CUT controls and cinematic status HUD.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look - installs scripts/look-trip.js as full-screen post-processing look.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU score clock, section lookup and seeded camera path; used by player/camera/HUD and stage.
scripts/lib/deck.js - deterministic per-seed scene-deck deal and track-to-scene-time mapping; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/visions.js - ten-being registry, four marked built, seeded slot dealing, vision camera shots and measured-energy lookup; used by cine.js and stage.js.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml and shots.yml - musical sections, layers, lens, scene-deck choices and authored camera keys; energy.yml holds measured track data and vision slots.
scripts/lib/trip.js - shared shader clocks, kick runs, seeded palette/random choices, scene/layer visibility, lens bending and vision visibility/clocks.
scripts/field-lib.js, eye-lib.js, tunnel-lib.js, chamber-lib.js and chamber-fx.js - family-specific spatial, timing and shader helpers.
scripts/sun-lib.js - sun-eye shader helpers; scripts/serpents-data.js and serpents-curve.js - shared serpent records, spine and frame math.
notableExports: scripts/player.js exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js exports finiteNumber, update; scripts/stage.js exports update.
scripts/lib/cine.js exports SCORE, SHOTS, CINE, cineTime, sectionAt, rollRnd, cameraAt, beatEnv; scripts/lib/deck.js exports dealDeck, sceneTime.
scripts/lib/visions.js exports BEINGS, dealVisions, visionAt, visionShot, energyAt; scripts/lib/trip.js exports KICK_RUNS, tripClock, shown, lens, bendUv, visionShown, visionU and masks.
scripts/look-trip.js exports look; field geometry/material scripts export geometry/material, with field-mandala.js exporting material.
scripts/eye-*-geo.js export geometry/collider where defined; eye shader scripts export material.
scripts/serpents-*-geo.js export geometry (and collider where defined); serpent layer materials export material; serpents-lib.js exports shared skin, clock, movement, lighting and cut helpers.

scripts/tunnel-geo.js exports geometry/collider; tunnel layer scripts export material; scripts/chamber-*-geo.js and vision-*-geo.js export geometry/collider where defined and paired shader scripts export material.
scripts/sun-lib.js exports shared sun helpers; sun layer scripts export material.
ownership: scripts/player.js - local movement intent/velocity and shared world.state.cine = {start, by, seed} or null from cine input.
scripts/stage.js on #director - shared audio session; trip materials and look receive t0/on/seed/kick/deck params, and vision-tagged materials receive their dealt vw0/vw1 slots.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - viewer-local camera pose/FOV and seeded authored or vision shot path.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - avatar gait/sit state; scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - viewer-local presentation only.
places/main/config.yaml owns atmosphere, spawn, gravity, terrain mode and look params; world.config.yaml owns world services, inputs and templates.
flows: P/cine action or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine={start: now+300ms, by, seed} or null.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → viewer-local ROLL/CUT and rolling progress/section label.
world.state.cine + score track → #director scripts/stage.js → shared audio at c.start; director stops audio and clears/renews ended cine.
stage.js → trip-tagged materials/look params: t0, on, seed, kick bounds k0/k1 and dealt scene mappings ds0..ds3/dr0..dr3.
stage.js + visions.js → objects tagged vision-<id> get vw0/vw1 slot seconds, or -1/-1 when not dealt; trip.js visionShown/visionU gate and clock their shaders.
energy.yml → trip.js KICK_RUNS and visions.js measured vision slots → director supplies kick runs and seeded vision slot assignment.
score.yml + deck.js → seeded scene per drop stretch → cine.js cameraAt and trip.js scene clock use the same assigned source section/rate.
cine.js cameraAt → visions.js visionAt/visionShot during a dealt slot, otherwise seeded shots.yml path → scripts/camera.js viewer camera.
score.yml + trip.js tripClock/shown/lens/mask helpers → field, eye, serpents, tunnel, chamber, vision assemblies and look-trip shader timing, cutouts and UV effects.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene serpents layers → serpents geometry/material family; serpents-lib.js and serpents-curve.js share body movement, skin and curve/frame math.
scripts/sun-lib.js → sun-eye disc/drips/halo shaders; tunnel-geo.js kind-selected geometry → tunnel wall/core/dust/gates/ribs and knot layers.
places/main/config.yaml atmosphere.look params → scripts/look-trip.js; world.config.yaml movement actions → scripts/player.js velocity, while templates/player.js also runs avatar locomotion.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/field-* - mandala, stalks, orbs and glyph/cartouche field layers share field-lib.js placement/timing while geometry and materials vary motifs.
scripts/eye-* - iris, pupil, rays, lids, beads and knot make the portal; eye-lib.js shares eye math and iris geometry is reused for pupil with different parameters.
scripts/serpents-* - co-located layers build striped/scaled bodies, arches, beads, cones, knots, rose beads and totem; serpents-lib.js/serpents-curve.js share appearance and spine/frame calculations.
scripts/tunnel-* - wall, core, dust, gates, ribs and knot share tunnel geometry kinds and tunnel-lib.js spatial/color helpers; materials vary motif and seeded palette.
scripts/chamber-* - room, circuit, hands, hex, Lissajous, solids and bilateral mask share chamber shader helpers and scored cutouts.
scripts/sun-disc.js, sun-drips.js and sun-halo.js - sun-eye layers share sun-lib.js but vary disc, hanging-drip and depth-halo imagery.

scripts/vision-*-geo.js and vision-*-mat.js - four built vision beings share trip/slot shader gating but use distinct geometry/material imagery; sun-father and moon-mother reuse one material across three depth/layer variants.

scripts/look-trip.js and scripts/lib/trip.js - full-screen post-processing and scene shaders share score clock, seeded scene deal, visibility and lens math; templates/player.js composes gait with input/movement.
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js and scripts/lib/data/world.yml - terrain generator/data without a consumer while main terrain is off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/pebble.js - meadow decoration scripts with no current place consumer.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine is the synchronized start/cut source; starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead. cine.js uses milliseconds for start/ctx.now() and seconds for score/shot keys.

stage.js converts c.start to shader t0 seconds modulo 3600 and repeats parameter pushes over several ticks so late-built materials receive the roll; tagged trip materials need t0/on/seed and kick bounds k0/k1.

There are two synchronized clocks: trip.js maps each dealt drop stretch to scene time sec for layer/lens composition, while real track time remains authoritative for beats, kicks and vision slots; ds0..ds3 are source starts and dr0..dr3 rates.

energy.yml remains the measured-track source for kick runs and vision slots; visions.js has ten deck IDs but only sun-father, moon-mother, contour-oracle and many-armed are marked built and have scene assemblies. Slot values vw0/vw1 are track seconds.

Score is 198 seconds at 160 bpm, first beat 0.35 s; idle shaders free-run the duration loop. Units are metres, +Y up, vision canvases face +Z; main composition runs from field/eye through tunnel to chamber on -Z.

Layer visibility is shader cutout via shown()/masks, not a fade to black; hidden layers uncover what is behind. Vision materials use visionShown/visionU and their scene objects must retain matching vision-<id> tags for stage slot propagation.
